summary.zh: 用行为科学原理优化页面、报价与活动设计
summary.en: Apply persuasion science to pages, offers and campaigns

description.zh: 从 70 多个行为科学模型中挑选合适的思路，解释用户为什么购买、如何被推动，并落到页面、报价和活动设计上。适合需要为某个转化决定找依据时使用。
description.en: Draws on 70+ behavioral science models to explain why people buy and how to nudge them, then applies the reasoning to pages, offers and campaigns. Good when a conversion call needs a defensible basis.
